title: In 1974, Australian ranger proposed wildlife bridge; 52 years later, it opened over motorway
summary_full: An innovative wildlife crossing, born from an Australian park ranger's fifty-two-year-old vision, has finally been realized. Cawleys Bridge has been modified to facilitate safe passage for important wildlife across a bustling motorway. This enhancement allows species like koalas to navigate between vital habitats such as Heathcote National Park and Garrawarra State Conservation Area. Future wildlife monitoring will assess usage patterns and guide subsequent conservation projects.
